facts.fact: Angola's Justice Minister says the Bilhete de Identidade results from integrating data in the birth record through interoperability between the respective computer systems.

systems.owner: Ministério da Justiça e dos Direitos Humanos

AGO.note: No count or share of people enrolled is given; only about 120,000 issued cards awaiting collection.

facts.fact: Angola's Justice Minister says the second phase of the universalisation plan provides for issuing the BI at birth in maternity hospitals with civil registration services.

AGO.note: No statement on who operates or owns the platform.
No public register keyed on the ID number is mentioned.

facts.fact: Angola's Justice Minister says the Bilhete de Identidade is now printed in all 21 provinces under the Universalisation Plan.
